en-US.longDescription:
Vovsoft Link Analyzer is a user-friendly software that allows users to delve into the structure of any input URL and thoroughly examine all the links present within the webpage. Whether you're a web developer, SEO professional, or simply curious about the links on a website, this URL analyzer software is your go-to tool for in-depth link analysis. The program will list all links on a webpage with ease. It can export the results into CSV or TXT files.

This software has been specifically developed for Windows operating system, making it compatible with both laptops and desktop computers. You can conveniently utilize it on your PC.

In addition to website URLs, you can analyze HTML files on your computer. In this way, you can detect broken links in your bookmarks. Drag and drop is also supported.

Key Features:
* Link Type: When viewing the extracted links, the software classifies each link as either internal or external. This distinction helps you understand how the website connects to other internal pages or external websites.
* Follow Attribute: You can instantly identify the type of follow attribute associated with each link. It clearly indicates whether a link is dofollow, passing on link authority for search engines, or nofollow, which instructs search engines not to follow the link for ranking purposes.
* Anchor Text: The software displays the anchor text used for each hyperlink. This feature enables you to comprehend the context of the links and how they relate to the content on the webpage. Understanding anchor text is crucial for optimizing SEO and ensuring a website's relevancy in search results.
* File Export: Save and export the link analysis results in various formats, such as CSV or TXT, for further examination or reporting purposes. This feature is particularly useful for SEO audits and generating insightful reports for clients or internal analysis.
* Check Broken Links: Verify the presence of any dead hyperlinks within the provided URL.
